report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with mostly low latency (62-78ms); one 344ms sample and a 425ms p95 are not clearly anomalous without a baseline. Traces show healthy downstream calls and pool idle=1, and no errors appear in logs or metrics (502 count=0). Healthy telemetry contradicts a fault hypothesis, so no bounded root cause is established; hand off for baseline and dependency-latency evidence.
missing_evidence: Sustained latency/error metrics for /v1/checkout over a longer window to confirm whether the 344ms sample is anomalous or normal tail
Baseline p95 latency for /v1/checkout to compare against observed 425ms p95
Downstream dependency latency breakdown (order, inventory, payment, postgres, redis) to localize any slow hop
Error-rate or saturation metrics for downstream services to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or redis-timeout
